summary.name: wireguard-apple
summary.one_liner: Git repository page for the iOS and macOS apps of the WireGuard VPN, maintained by Jason A. Donenfeld, showing branches, tags, and commit history.
use_cases: Downloading source tarballs of WireGuard iOS/macOS app releases
Reviewing commit history of the WireGuard Apple apps
Browsing branches and tags of the wireguard-apple project
Cloning the WireGuard Apple source code
summary.what_it_does:
This page is the gitweb view of the wireguard-apple repository, which contains the iOS and macOS apps for WireGuard. It lists branches (such as master and several feature branches from Andrej Mihajlov and Alessio Nossa) and release tags from 0.0.20200127-17 up to 1.0.16-27. Each tag has downloadable .tar.xz and .zip archives. The page also shows the recent commit log, with the latest entry on master being a version bump dated 2023-02-15. Clone URLs for HTTPS, git, and SSH are provided.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Official WireGuard source repository for the Apple iOS and macOS apps
Includes WireGuardKit and WireGuardKitGo components, per commit messages
Latest tag 1.0.16-27 with the master branch last updated 2023-02-15
Code is MIT licensed per the commit 'global: apply MIT more consistently'
caveats: Page shows repository history only; the last visible commits are from 2023, so it may not reflect current development
Does not describe end-user setup or features of the apps themselves
